searchUrl.title: Search URL (Optional)
searchUrl.description: Direct ZipRecruiter search URL. When supplied, it is the only search mode used and other search filters are ignored.

searchQuery.title: Search Query / Keywords
searchQuery.description: Job title or keywords to search for. Use this when searchUrl is not supplied.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional location filter, such as New York, NY, California, or Remote.

maxJobs.title: Maximum Jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of job listings to save. Use 0 to continue until the page limit or source results are exhausted.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of result pages or continuation batches to request.

scrapeMode.title: Scrape Mode
scrapeMode.description: listing_only is fastest. listing_with_details is retained for compatibility and includes descriptions when the source provides them.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy configuration. A US residential or unblocker proxy is recommended because ZipRecruiter may block datacenter traffic.
